source: Based on the genotype, M. tuberculosis has seven lineages: three 'ancient' (lineage-1 and two Mycobacterium africanum lineages), and three 'modern' (lineages-2, 3, 4) (Comas et al., 2009), and one intermediate (lineage-7), recently described in Ethiopia (Firdessa et al., 2013).

claim: The genome of Mycobacterium tuberculosis is stable compared to other bacteria.
